dedupe_keys.name: buenos aires lidar 3d scans of nine public buildings edificios publicos en 3d

description: Subsecretaría de Planeamiento, Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires publishes LiDAR scans of nine landmark public buildings in Buenos Aires: the Casa Rosada, the city Legislature, the Cabildo, the Superior Court of Justice, the Metropolitan Cathedral, the Centro Cultural Kirchner, the National Congress, Dique 3 in Puerto Madero and the Teatro Colón. Coverage: nine individual buildings in the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; one archive per building; the portal record was last modified on 2025-06-30. Format and access: ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: only nine buildings are covered, so it is a set of heritage-building scans, not a city model; the archive contents, point density and file format inside the ZIP and RAR files were not opened; several archives are marked as RAR files. Simulation uses: reference geometry for structural and heritage-building studies, a test set for point-cloud processing, and detailed models for visualisation in a city digital twin. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
